quest.title: Legends of the Stone Lock
quest.description: After unlocking the stone lock in Sumeru, and defeating the monsters trapped in the seal, you will be entrusted by Aranara to defeat other sealed monsters.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.text: Oh no, the stone lock is gone!
Who could have broken the lock? Could it be the Big Iron Chunk?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's an Aranara...
Eh? The Golden Nara and the silver bird can see Aradashan?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon is not a silver bird! And gold... Well, this is {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Okay, Aradashan gets it. It's Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Aradashan's name is Aradashan.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Hmmm... You're a Golden Nara, with the same Golden hair as Nara Varuna, with the warm scent of a sun-kissed leaf...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Oh, but now is not the time to make friends. The stone lock... Did you see who broke it, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The stone lock is probably what we just opened...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We did indeed break it...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #No, so Nara {NICKNAME} was the one breaking the lock...? Aradashan thought the Big Iron Chunks escaped on their own!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: The stone lock is gone! The Big Iron Chunk is coming out!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #You should hide, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Big Iron Chunks are big and hard, some even shoot fire out of their eyes! Very dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you mean the monster trapped inside? We've dealt with it already.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Really? So the Big Iron Chunk was destroyed? Great news! Aradashan was about to shed leaves at the thought of them pouring out!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #So Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon took down the Big Iron Chunk here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've taken loads of monsters like them down in the past!

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #Aradashan didn't expect Nara {NICKNAME} to be so powerful. Uh, can Nara {NICKNAME} help...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it be related to the stone locks?

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: So smart, Paimon! Aradashan is somewhat a bit surprised...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is there to be surprised about!?

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: Hehe, yes, it is related to the stone locks.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #There are sixteen stone locks in total in the forest with Big Iron Chunks inside... Can {NICKNAME} defeat them?

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #Oh, Nara {NICKNAME} is such a nice Nara. Aradashan thanks Nara {NICKNAME} from the bottom of Aradashan's heart!

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: Come see Aradashan once you've beaten all the Big Iron Chunks!

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: If you could beat all the Big Iron Chunks, you must also be able to...

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #Heh, Aradashan will save that for when Nara {NICKNAME} comes back!

choices.text: Have you really helped in any combat?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon knows just where to hide!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #You're very powerful, Nara {NICKNAME}. We'll defeat the Bulky Iron Chunk for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Will we defeat the Bulky Iron Chunk? It is a terrible monster as told in the legends... Uhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: It is said the Bulky Iron Chunk has many forms and can turn into many Big Iron Chunks.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #But it will be vulnerable once you beat any of its key parts, so watch carefully, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: I don't speak to Nara often.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Thank you, nice Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Whoa, Aradashan didn't think that the Bulky Iron Chunk would still be so strong after we used Ararakalari.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Even if our Ararakalari could defeat Big Iron Chunks, we wouldn't be able to handle the Bulky Iron Chunk.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #If Nara {NICKNAME} hadn't been here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay, since the Perpetual Mechanical Array... Uh, Bulky Iron Chunk is defeated, there will be no more iron monsters in the forests!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, you can rest assured now.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: ...Must rely on ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #Arasaha is right. Seeing Nara {NICKNAME} fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk had us in awe.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: There is still a long way to go before catching up with the great Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: We must train harder, so we can be heroes like Aradasha in the next crisis!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: We must fight the imaginary Bulky Iron Chunk in our dream!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go for it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I know you'll get there.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #When you want to, Nara {NICKNAME}, just sing the Rhythm of the Great Dream like when you entered Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Then you can join and share our dream of the Bulky Iron Chunk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Somehow that sounds more like a nightmare...

choices.text: Do you dream about fighting, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't want to dream about fighting! Paimon only wants to dream about eating delicious food!

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: Aradashan will go train in dreams with Arasata, Arayuta, and Arasaha now!

response.speaker: Arasata
response.text: #As a sign of my gratitude, Nara {NICKNAME}, I shall remember you with the first ray of dawn.

response.speaker: Arayuta
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, is as great as Nara Varuna!

response.speaker: Arasaha
response.text: ...You will not be forgotten.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: Yes, let's meet again in the dream later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, it's their dream, after all. The Perpetual Mechanical Array won't be real and we won't get hurt.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #Oh! Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are so amazing! Now Aradashan knows why the air and ground in the forest have become cleaner.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: Wait for Aradashan! Aradashan is going to get the friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Friends?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So many Aranara appeared out of nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, these are Arasata, Arasaha, and Arayuta.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: More Aranara names! Aradashan, Arasata, Arasaha, and...

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Arayuta! My name is Arayuta!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon's got it, Arayuta!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Paimon knows my name now. I'm so happy!

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Hello... I am Arasata.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: ...Arasaha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aradashan, you told us to come see you after we're done with all the Big Iron Chunks... What for?

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Oh, it goes way, way back...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Several hundred cycles of trees ago, the iron monsters appeared. Some were big iron Nara, some were legless big iron Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: The monsters were as tall as mountains, spewing light as bright as fire. They made the forests weep and bushes wail in the howling fire.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean the Big Iron Chunks?

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: That's more or less correct...

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Let me tell the story from that point on. I like the rest part of the story.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: When things were at their most perilous, the great Aradasha emerged.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: The great Aradasha defeated many, many Big Iron Chunks with Ararakalari and locked them up with stone locks.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Just like that, the great Aradasha restored peace to much foliage, allowing Nara and Aranara to rest in the forest at night.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, all the Ruin Graders and Ruin Drakes and stuff from the stone locks we unlocked were defeated and confined by Aradasha!?

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Yeah, Aradasha was super powerful, taking on all those Big Iron Chunks like that! Aradasha stories are my favorites!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But if the Big Iron Chunks that Aradasha put away have been defeated by {NICKNAME}, why did you want us to come here?

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Well... Aradasha locked the Big Iron Chunks away, but even the hardest earth erodes and crumbles in time...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Same as the stone locks. They crack and fracture until they become Valuka.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Then the Big Iron Chunks can shrug off the stone locks to bring doom to the woods. So, we must guard the locks.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: But it would be bad if we should miss any loose locks, so Aradashan, Arasata, Arasaha, and Arayuta must become more powerful.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: If we could defeat them with Ararakalari like Arabalika can, we wouldn't have to worry about the stone locks turning into Valuka.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you wanted to beat the Big Iron Chunks yourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... How did that become our problem?

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Uh, we can't defeat the Big Iron Chunks right now, so if we released them from those stone locks just like that...

choices.text: That would indeed be very dangerous.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #But Nara {NICKNAME} is powerful and can defeat the Big Iron Chunks. With Nara {NICKNAME}'s help, we can beat the mighty Bulky Iron Chunk!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you called us here to deal with the Bulky Iron Chunk?

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: Bulky Iron Chunk is mightier than Big Iron Chunk. We could only contain it with our Ararakalari.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #So when Aradashan saw Nara {NICKNAME} defeat Big Iron Chunks, Aradashan thought Nara {NICKNAME} could defeat Bulky Chunk.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #So Aradashan would like to ask Nara {NICKNAME} for another favor...

choices.text: Whatever kind of iron chunk it is.

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #Oh, Nara {NICKNAME} is such a nice Nara!

response.speaker: Arayuta
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} glows as bright as gold, just like Nara Varuna did in the tales!

response.speaker: Arasata
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is so helpful, like the rain in a drought!

response.speaker: Arasaha
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you said that the Bulky Iron Chunk is under a lake, right? So, how will we get there?

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: It's okay. We just need to lower the water level and make a passage!

response.speaker: Aradashan
response.text: #Please wait a while, Nara {NICKNAME}, and we'll see you in the lake.

talks.objective: Go to the cavern Aradashan mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we beat all the monsters that were locked up by the stones!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Heh, Aradashan believed Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon could do that for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is the Bulky Iron Chunk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since the Big Iron Chunks are Ruin Graders, Ruin Drakes, and the likes... It's no surprise that the Bulky Iron Chunk was actually a Perpetual Mechanical Array...

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Strange. Why do you call the Bulky Iron Chunk "Perlulu Manacle Array"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, the name will fit pretty soon... But we'll stick to calling it Bulky Iron Chunk for now.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Bulky Iron Chunk!

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #The Bulky Iron Chunk can fly and crash down like a meteor. Be careful, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: ...Be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #We'll help you by using our Ararakalari, Nara {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Release the Bulky Iron Chunk when you're ready!
